\begin{chapstatus}{The thread of this chapter}
andi t3, t0, 1 is a row of 32 AND gates: Boolean algebra describes both the instruction and the circuit. Next: from a truth table to the smallest circuit.
\par\medskip\textbf{Exit ticket} (two to four minutes, alone, on paper):
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item Analysis or synthesis? (a) Given a schematic, find its truth table. (b) Given 'the light is on when exactly one of two switches is up', build a circuit. (c) Read andi t3, t0, 1 and say what ends up in t3.
\item Write one instruction that sets bit 3 of t0 to 1 and leaves the other bits unchanged, and one that clears it.
\end{enumerate}
\end{chapstatus}
